defeat_blood_A.png.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: subtle defeat overlay for a dark-fantasy auto-battle party RPG web UI.
Output: landscape 1536x1024 PNG with a real alpha channel. All empty space must be fully transparent (alpha 0), not painted black, white, or checkerboard. Only blood has opacity. This is an isolated overlay asset, not a screenshot.
Style: painterly but clean dark fantasy, deep crimson to near-black red (#5a0008 to #a3101a), restrained slightly glossy highlights, not neon or cartoonish. Small coverage, at most 10-15% of total canvas. Underlying hero/monster cards must remain readable: center approximately 70% of the image must remain completely empty and transparent.
Avoid: frame, text, characters, weapons, background color, background scene, vignette fill, haze in empty areas, organs, wounds, bodies, gore.
Image A — top drip: a thin irregular band of blood touches and runs along the TOP edge only. Exactly 8 narrow drips of varied lengths descend from this band. The single longest drip reaches about 30% of the canvas height; most reach only 5-15%. Two drips have small rounded droplets attached at their tips. Keep the band thin and the drips slender and understated, with abundant untouched transparent space between them. No blood on the left, right, or bottom edges. The lower 70% remains fully transparent.
